text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even closer to your side...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing quietly on the wedding aisle,
Nishino Flower said those words softly. As I walked up to her,
I looked back on the journey that brought us here...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, next time... would you mind helping me
with a photoshoot for my new outfit?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Actually, Beauty Anshinzawa has sent over quite a few requests.
choice_data_list: Sure, but what kind of request is it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, apparently they need an escort partner
for the photoshoot. And so, I was wondering
if I could ask you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She said it was needed to highlight the outfit. Since she promised my face wouldn't be shown, I agreed to take the job.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah! In that suit, Trainer,
you look so sleek and cool!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Seeing you in a suit makes you look
like such a mature woman, Trainer! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... your tie is crooked.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho... There, all done!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Ah, I'm sorry!
I shouldn't have meddled......!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mom used to do that whenever Dad headed out for work...
so I just did it out of habit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. You're very welcome.
Something like this is no trouble at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after having her appearance tidied up,
the photoshoot inside the church finally began.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text: Okay! Looks like it's going well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, is the shoot over already?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"During that shoot, though...
I couldn't meet your eyes, Trainer...
Because of our height difference..."

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
No, you had a great expression.
Besides, the Trainer won't be on camera,
so you don't need to worry about that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: B-But...! Um—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I felt the expression was a bit awkward.
Since I had to sculpt it from imagination..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I think it really is easier to pour your feelings into it... when you're looking right into each other's eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Then, shall we have
Trainer take a seat?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
Trainer, this way, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her instructions, I sat down
and faced Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... hehe.
Hehehe... It feels kinda strange and mysterious.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Your face, Trainer.
This might be the first time I've seen it up close like this.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
That's a great expression!
Please keep it right there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, please... don't look away.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right now, um... I want you to look only at me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...In order to take good photos.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um~...
I just felt like I was trying way too hard today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Aaah, my face is burning...!
choice_data_list: We ended up getting a great shot, didn't we?
We got a great photo in the end, didn't we?
True, she did seem more mature than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Aaah, my face is burning...!
choice_data_list: We ended up getting a great shot, didn't we?
We got a great photo in the end, didn't we?
True, she did seem more mature than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is that so, I wonder...?
choice_data_list: You're great at setting the mood!
You're great at setting the mood!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's not that I made it, more like... I just got a little carried away...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you say so,
then maybe it was for the best after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are things to be gained only by taking things seriously.
It proved to be a valuable new learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah! Don't say it!
I just couldn't help myself~!
choice_data_list: Still, you looked really mature back then.
Still, you looked really mature back then.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't say it like that~!!
Auugh..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're being a little mean...
Mmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed home, apologizing profusely
to Nishino Flower, who was completely cross with me.
